messages:
maya: Heads-up — incoming customer ask via support INT-4328 (Acme). They want: Terraform provider updates, JS/Python SDK token rotation helper, SSO/SCIM group attrs, and a marketplace listing. Link to ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/4328
request-tracker-bot: New intake created • INT-4328 • submitter: Acme Corp • severity: medium • attachments: sample SCIM payload
lina: Acme is pushing procurement — they need idP-initiated SSO + group mapping (dept) for HR sync. They asked for ETA to include in contract review. :eyes:
sam: Quick scope check please: 1) TF provider: add service_account auth + examples, 2) SDKs: rotation helper + example, 3) SSO: idp-init + SCIM user + group mapping. Anything missing?
andrew: Terraform note — current provider v0.2 expects user token; we should add service_account flow and a `redwood_service_account` resource. JS/Py helper should be small. For SCIM, they included a custom attr `urn:custom:department` — need to accept and persist unknown attrs.
maya: They pasted SCIM sample in the ticket: ```{ "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"], "externalId": "u123", "urn:custom:department": "Engineering" }``` — they expect those custom attrs preserved in mapping.
jess: Security checkpoint: SCIM sync will carry emails and possibly PII. For Hosted, we need clear consent wording and audit logs; for Private we must ensure KMS/HSM usage and retention controls. Tag as security-review.
kyle: Confirm whether they use SAML or OIDC for SSO (or both). SAML idp-init can be more involved.
sam: Proposed triage: tag = intake/integration, prio=P2, epic=integration/ssoscim-marketplace. Launch criteria: SDK + TF examples, e2e SCIM test, docs, security signoff. Thoughts?
lina: Procurement said they'd accept P2 if we can give a firm Q3 ETA. They need a roadmap entry to close procurement review.
jess: Realistic delivery: SDK helper + TF auth + docs = ~3 sprints. Full SCIM with group mapping + idp-init = 5-6 sprints. Suggest MVP: user SCIM sync (no group mapping) + idp-initiated SSO deferred.
sam: Scope negotiation: offer MVP = TF provider auth + SDK rotation helper + SCIM basic user sync + marketplace listing. Advanced group mapping and idp-init as follow-up (or professional services).
maya: Customer said MVP would be acceptable if ETA is 8-10 weeks. They've asked to be notified when it hits roadmap.
andrew: I'll pick up SDK + TF provider. I'll need an example service_account from Acme to test. Will open GH issue and add PR template.
request-tracker-bot: Linked GH issue: https://github.com/redwoodinc/integration-requests/issues/2891 • tags: intake/integration, prio:P2, owner:@andrew
sam: I'll add Linear ticket with tags: integrations, customer-ask, marketplace, needs-rfc and draft an RFC by EOW. We'll include launch criteria and rollout plan (canary for Hosted, docs for Dedicated/Private).
maya: Scheduled a 30min sync with Acme next Tue 10am PT to confirm scope and demo MVP plan. I'll update ticket after the call.
lina: :thumbsup: capturing procurement note and pushing timeline to legal team.
jess: Reminder — docs must call out Dedicated/Private differences (KMS/HSM, audit endpoints, network requirements). Add a security checklist for the review.
andrew: Adding test matrix: hosted/dedicated/private x token-rotation x scim attrs. Will include sample data and automated e2e for basic user sync.
sam: Decision: Move to product backlog as P2 with tag intake/integration. Owner: @andrew. Next steps: Andrew create GH issue (link to INT-4328), Sam draft RFC by EOW, schedule security review. Leaving scope as MVP as discussed.
maya: Thanks everyone — @andrew ping here when the GH issue is up and I'll update the support ticket and the customer.
